report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency degradation, but current telemetry contradicts it: gateway traces show OK checkout at 60ms, and gateway, order, payment, and inventory all report error_rate 0.001 and p95 73ms. Order shows retained heap after GC (260MB, 3 WARNs), but a short increase alone cannot establish a leak, and no evidence ties it to checkout impact. Insufficient evidence for any bounded root cause; hand off.
missing_evidence: Current telemetry showing elevated checkout error rate or latency (all services report error_rate 0.001, p95 73ms)
Sustained memory-retention time series for order service to distinguish leak from transient retention
Order service heap/GC trend and allocation rate over a longer window
Evidence linking order retained heap to checkout errors or latency
